title: Planning electric bus systems with solar photovoltaic integration using open transit data: A case study of the Dakar BRT
summary: Electrification of urban bus systems is expected to accelerate due to its clear environmental benefits. However, effective electric bus deployment requires planning tools that can support decision-making on electrification strategies while balancing operational feasibility, costs, environmental benefits, and impacts on the local electricity grid.
